how: We read the website of every Pittsburgh wedding photographer listed on Lazo (68 listings, 57 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: senior-portrait and family studios where weddings are a sideline, a photo booth company, a part-time shooter who also films podcasts, and sites with little more than a gallery. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Can I see a full gallery from a Pittsburgh wedding in my season, including a gray winter day or a church-to-reception gap?
Is a second shooter included, and what is the delivery timeline for the full gallery?
How do you plan portraits around the rivers and bridges, and the traffic on a Steelers or Pitt home-game Saturday?

picks.name: Tyler Norman Photography
picks.blurb: Since 2008, Tyler Norman Photography has photographed more than 800 weddings, in a style it calls meaningful, timeless and romantic. A Pittsburgh wedding and lifestyle photographer who talks about heirlooms rather than Instagram moments.

picks.name: Dawn Derbyshire Photography
picks.blurb: Fifteen-plus years and more than 600 weddings, with bold, colorful, real-life images and a promise that all love is welcome. Dawn, based in West View, calls herself your hype woman and says she will climb rocks for the shot and keep camera-shy partners at ease.

picks.name: Alison Mish Photography
picks.blurb: A Pittsburgh wedding photographer since 2011, Alison shot her first wedding two weeks before her own. Wife to her high school sweetheart and mom of four, she photographs for, in her words, the romantic in all of us.

picks.name: Leeann Marie Photography
picks.blurb: More than 17 years as a Pittsburgh wedding photographer and over 500 weddings, in a classic and contemporary style built on timeless images and candid moments. Leeann also photographs newborns and families on her wooded studio property, but weddings are where her career began.

picks.name: Linnea Marie Photography
picks.blurb: Editorial wedding photography in digital and analog film for modern and moody souls, from a Pittsburgh photographer 14 years in the industry. Packages for Pittsburgh and Washington, D.C. start at $6,500 for an inclusive day of coverage, and the site notes a Knot Best of Weddings 2025 award.

picks.name: Mike Christ Photography
picks.blurb: Photojournalistic with a loose artistic, editorial approach, following the energy of the day rather than running long photo sessions. Mike has a fine art degree and spent ten years as a graphic designer; packages start at $3,000 and tiny weddings and elopements are a specialty.

picks.name: Adam Michaels Photography
picks.blurb: A brother-and-sister team, Adam and Jade, serving Pittsburgh weddings for over ten years. Adam started the company in 2016 and brought Jade on full-time by 2020, and the site lays out its business model and package information up front.

picks.name: J Eidenmiller Photography
picks.blurb: Justin and Jocelyn Eidenmiller are a husband-and-wife team based in the Greater Pittsburgh area and available worldwide, with true-to-life imagery for adventurous spirits and timeless romantics, from full weddings to elopements.

picks.name: Carly Ferraco Photography
picks.blurb: Light, bright and candid wedding photography with a timeless approach, blending an editorial eye with a documentary one. Carly serves the greater Western Pennsylvania area and offers videography alongside photography for weddings, engagements and surprise proposals.

picks.name: Jackson Signature Photography
picks.blurb: A Latrobe studio run by Tiffany and her husband, photographing weddings since 2008 in a timeless, joy-filled style across Western Pennsylvania, Ohio and destinations worldwide, with senior portraits on the side.

picks.name: Allisha Linnea Photography
picks.blurb: Since 2011, Allisha has photographed more than 200 weddings across Western Pennsylvania in a filmic, moody style, working from Saltsburg near Indiana, PA. She studied graphic design, and every package includes digital images with printing rights.

picks.name: Carl S. Miller Weddings
picks.blurb: Observant, classic, deeply human photographs that blend documentary storytelling with timeless portraiture, for couples who value the people and character of a celebration. Pittsburgh and destination weddings, from a photographer who left grad school for the camera.
